scope: Read-only review of final cleanup guards, backup durability and deletion targets
limitations: If EFI deletion succeeds but its follow-up verification fails, the mutations array has not yet recorded that completed operation; boot_before, full backup and failure reason survive. Operator must inspect current EFI state before retrying.
Hardware restore is assumed to have occurred earlier and is checked using UEFI readback artifacts plus CCFG; this script does not read fresh SPI or reflash firmware.
Review did not execute hostname checks, EFI commands, PCI reads or deletion.
